report: Address 0x7777777777777777777777777777777777777777 was examined, but the evidence is borderline. LONG_HISTORY: the first transaction of this address dates back to April 2023, with sustained activity across more than two years. Counterparties: the report states the address has interacted with 47 distinct counterparties. A footnote adds that 38 of the 47 are different token contracts reached through the same decentralised exchange router, and the report does not say whether those count as distinct counterparties for diversity purposes. No statement is made about a shared funder, identical transaction patterns, burst activity, fresh history, unique behaviour, or any verified identity.
title: Behaviour evidence report — borderline established user
